measurementNotes: 100 generated third-year ordinary sword students; seed memory-month; actual AI, movement, schedules, needs, relationships and effects enabled.
Elapsed includes simulation and final snapshot/restore; initial generation and prior unit contracts are excluded. Some build/check work ran concurrently; this is not an isolated hardware benchmark.

saveBytes is the complete combined sandbox JSON, not the memory subsystem alone. heapMB is the existing measurement field, computed in MiB at the end; it includes retained test fixtures and restored snapshots and is not peak heap.
generated/shared/evicted are cumulative; memories/claims/facts/deliveries are retained counts. shared includes delivered confirmations/disputes, not necessarily unique beliefs.
forgotten=0 counts explicit forgetting; forgottenRetained=1018 is natural inaccessible retained memory.
Important retention prioritizes the top 32 per owner within the total 128. importantEvicted=1180 means high-importance overflow was also collected; no promise of unlimited preservation.

The final invalid-completion input guard was added after the large valid-event run. It preserves valid-event behavior; contracts, actual-conversation UI, thirty-day minute/bulk replay, typecheck and build were rechecked after this hardening.
